tx:
This ale is created through the random chance of player made ales matureing, while brewing Asgarnian ale. Maturing occurs during the Brewing process, not afterwards. Leaving normal ale in the vat once it has finished brewing will not cause it to turn mature or go bad. See the Brewing guide in the Cooking Guide.
As this ale is player made, it can be collected into a Calquat Keg, making an Asgarnian ale (m) (keg). Doing so allows the player to hold 4 doses of this beer in one inventory slot, increasing the value and usefulness of this brew several times over. Players can purchase these items from the grand exchange under the name Asgarnian ale (m4).

sc: The black guard warhammer is a warhammer obtained from Supreme Commander Bisi as part of a special assignment for Santiri.
While technically a non-members' item (since it can be used and examined on a non-members' world and has blue item text), it is only obtainable and useful for members.
Players obtain three of them whilst doing the Spirit of Summer quest, though they are not needed to complete the quest, and therefore players do not need to retain them.
This is one of the members items freely obtainable by free-to-play players, but it still cannot be consumed or traded in free worlds.
The Cadarn Ranger armour is an outfit that can be purchased for 6 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.

As a rare reward from fishing lobster (level 40 Fishing required) -- approximately 3 hours on average to get the egg.

The platebody (class 5) from the Stealing Creation minigame is made by using class 5 sacred clay on a creation kiln with 80 Smithing.
Like all sacred clay items, it can be traded freely between players who are on the same team during the minigame.
A premade cheese and tomato batta (spelled in-game as premade c+t batta) is a type of gnomish food that can be bought from the Gnome Waiter in the north-west corner of the of the Grand Tree.
The pet and its variants are unlocked by using Treasure Hunter keys to advance along the promotion's prize path.
A raw jubbly is obtained by killing a jubbly bird during, or after, the Recipe for Disaster quest (after having begun saving Skrach Uglogwee).

Replica Infinity (Air) Top.x: The Replica Infinity (Air) Top is a torso slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Replica Infinity Robes pack.

sc: Reverence is a tier 1 aura that can be bought from the Loyalty Programme Shop for 5,000 Loyalty Points.
Before a higher tier can be bought, previous tiers must also be bought.
It is found on Bloodsplatter Isle.
Once all of the items used to make the disguise are obtained, they can be given to Bill Teach.
They can be made at a forge and anvil using 1 rune bar and rune armoured boots, requiring 480 progress to complete, granting a total of 240 Smithing experience.
The plateskirt requires 50 defence to wear and cannot be made using the smithing skill.
Players can obtain a rune plateskirt (Armadyl) as a reward from completing a level 4 Treasure Trail.
It can be purchased from the Daemonheim Rewards shop for 40,000 Dungeoneering tokens.
Like all sacred clay items, it can be traded freely between players who are on the same team during the minigame.
The Scorpion cage is an item obtained from Thormac at the beginning of the Scorpion Catcher quest.
It is used to capture the scorpions which are found in: Taverley Dungeon, the Barbarian Outpost, and the Edgeville Monastery.
Seren's Crystal Tiara is an item obtained by activating the Crystal Grace relic in the Equilibrium League.
Soma is a relic obtained using the Archaeology skill.
Instructions on how to make it can be found in Skeka's tablet within the observation outpost's ruins, but do not need to be read to complete.
Speedy whirligig shells are obtained when hunting speedy whirligigs inside Het's Oasis.

Staff of light (yellow).x: The staff of light is a two-handed staff that requires 75 Magic to wield. It is obtained as a unique drop from ice strykewyrms, requiring 93 Slayer to kill. Recoloured staves must be returned to the original colour before adding an augmentor to create an augmented staff of light.

The lumpy, hardening tin is created by using a vial of liquid on the gypsum filled tin.
